decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the  extensions are occupied.

Condition : 4 - The roof lights formed on the southeast roof plane shall be flat conservation style rooflights and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with flat conservation style rooflights
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
